lines.en: I walk on the birch leaves

lines.zh: 肩上扛着的东西，走起来一晃
lines.en: What I carry on my shoulder sways as I walk

lines.zh: 我个子不高，步子倒是长
lines.en: I am not tall, and my stride is long

lines.zh: 山地上的石头，我一步跨过去
lines.en: I step over the stones of the highlands

lines.zh: 我走在恶地的边上，不停留
lines.en: I walk the badland edge without lingering
I shake the parts on my body
I look up at the mountain, I mean to climb it

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可带的东西多
lines.en: I am not fast, but I carry a lot

lines.zh: 我在林子里找路，不照着走
lines.en: I find my own way through the woods

lines.zh: 我的影子只有一个，不长
lines.en: I cast one short shadow

lines.zh: 肩上这堆东西，是捡来的
lines.en: What I carry was picked up along the way
I pass and the leaves rustle

lines.zh: 我蹲在石头上，摆弄手里的东西
lines.en: I squat on a stone fiddling with something

lines.zh: 我这一身，都是拼起来的
lines.en: This body of mine is all assembled

lines.zh: 我把东西一件件排开看
lines.en: I lay my things out one by one
The wind up here is dry

lines.zh: 我盯着远处看了一会儿
lines.en: I stare into the distance a while
I cannot bear to throw away what I carry
Sitting does not suit me either

lines.zh: 我数着今天捡到的东西
lines.en: I count what I found today
These highlands are quiet

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻到风里的金属味
lines.en: I lift my head, there is metal on the wind
I squeeze the part in my hand

lines.zh: 我把最占地方的东西挪到背后
lines.en: I move the most cumbersome thing to my back
I sit, my hands never still

lines.zh: 你身上有没有能用的东西
lines.en: Do you have anything usable on you

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，先看你的装备
lines.en: I look up at you, your gear first
You came this far alone

lines.zh: 这种东西，你带着也没用
lines.en: You carry that and it does you no good
I am not good with people
Do not touch what is on my back
Put your hands down and I will talk
If you need a path, I know it better

lines.zh: 你身上有点东西，我认得
lines.en: There is something on you I recognize

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从上面看
lines.en: I dislike being looked at from above
This place is enough with just me
I move my things aside a little
Your tone is not right
If you want to trade, say it first

lines.zh: 你是个明白人，我能看出来
lines.en: You are a sensible one, I can tell

lines.zh: 我身上的东西掉了几件
lines.en: A few of my things fell off

lines.zh: 我蹲下去捡，先护着这些
lines.en: I crouch to gather, guarding them first
That left my hand shaking
I step back against a stone
It hurts, and I secure my load first

lines.zh: 我这一身是拼的，容易散
lines.en: This body is pieced together, easy to scatter
I grunt and say nothing
The load is there, and I am still up

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，是零件吗
lines.en: Is that a part in your hand
I look at it, it is usable
Anything else that works
Not scrap, this can be fitted
What do you want for it, say it
This is useless to you
I have pocketed it
Let me swap out the old one first
Do not shake, I am not snatching

lines.zh: 我把它翻过来，能装东西
lines.en: I turn it over, it can hold things

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我肩上的东西掉了
lines.en: You hit me and my load fell

lines.zh: 我弯腰拣，花了不少时间
lines.en: I bent to pick it up, it took a while
That put me back two steps
Do not touch what is on my shoulder

lines.zh: 我这一身都是拼的，不经撞
lines.en: This body is all pieced together, it does not take hits
You stepped on one of my parts
I shift aside and give you the road

lines.zh: 这一下，我身上的东西响了
lines.en: That set everything on me ringing
I do not like fighting, but I can fight

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我把东西放下
lines.en: Bump me again and I put my load down

lines.zh: 我这人，捡东西的时间更多
lines.en: I spend more time gathering than anything

lines.zh: 身上这堆东西，比人重要
lines.en: This load matters more than people
Will you gather with me

lines.zh: 山地这么大，一个人也够
lines.en: The highlands are wide, one is enough

lines.zh: 我不太会说话，你别介意
lines.en: I am not good with words, do not mind it

lines.zh: 你站远一点，我要清点东西
lines.en: Stand back, I need to count my things
This does not trade for a person

lines.zh: 你看我这样，能给你什么
lines.en: Look at me, what could I give you
I still prefer walking alone
Let us each keep to our own road
I crouch and turn it over
This is usable, I will keep it
A little old, and it still works

lines.zh: 我把它塞进肩上的堆里
lines.en: I stuff it into the pile on my shoulder

lines.zh: 我拆开看了看，里面是空的
lines.en: I took it apart, it is empty inside
I tossed it back

lines.zh: 这种东西，山地上一抓一把
lines.en: There are plenty of these in the highlands
Why are you picking that up
This one is yours now
I set down what I was carrying
This is my road

lines.zh: 你从下面上来，我看见你了
lines.en: You came up from below, I saw you

lines.zh: 我把手边的工具拿好了
lines.en: I have taken up the tool at hand

lines.zh: 一个人走这条路，不太明智
lines.en: Walking this road alone is unwise
Your scent is on the wind, quite fresh
I stand high, I see clearly

lines.zh: 这地方没什么能给外人的
lines.en: There is nothing here for outsiders
Turn back, it saves trouble
I press along the short way

lines.zh: 你脚下那块石头是松的
lines.en: That stone under your foot is loose
I follow by the short way
I know this ground better than you

lines.zh: 你拐进沟里，那头没有出口
lines.en: You turn into the gully, there is no way out
I have put my things away

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看你的动作
lines.en: I walk and watch your movements
There is no other path in this stretch

lines.zh: 你的脚步在石头上很响
lines.en: Your steps ring on the stone
I am in no hurry, I know this place
Stop, and I will wait
I take the high route, out of your sight
Every fork ahead is a dead end
Higher up is a cliff

lines.zh: 我用肩上的东西砸过去
lines.en: I swing what I carry at you
That scattered parts everywhere
You were knocked into the stone
That was the tool in my hand

lines.zh: 我打得不漂亮，可很实在
lines.en: My blows are not pretty, and they land
I rang your armor

lines.zh: 我退了，捡起地上的东西
lines.en: I retreat and pick up what fell
That numbed your arm
These parts of mine are not to be trifled with
You are at the edge of the slope

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就全砸出去
lines.en: Once more and I throw everything

lines.zh: 山地上多了一个背东西的影子
lines.en: A figure carrying a load has appeared on the highlands
I stand up from behind a stone

lines.zh: 身上的零件互相碰了一下
lines.en: My parts knocked together once
The leaves crunch under me

lines.zh: 我抬头看山，又低头看路
lines.en: I look up at the mountain, then down at the road
I come to this stretch often
I settle the load on my shoulder
The birch bark is very white

lines.zh: 风把我的耳朵吹得往后
lines.en: The wind pushes my ears back

lines.zh: 我落地时，脚边石头滚了
lines.en: When I landed, stones rolled at my feet

lines.zh: 山下有个人，我在上面看着
lines.en: There is someone below, I watch from above
I climb the slope step by step

lines.zh: 火烧到我肩上的东西，我赶紧拍
lines.en: Fire caught my load and I beat at it

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下来，零件撒了一路
lines.en: I slid down the slope, parts all along the way
Everything on me sank in the water
The blast scattered what I carried

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我肩上那堆东西里
lines.en: An arrow stuck in the load on my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股劲儿让我手里的零件掉了
lines.en: That force knocked the part from my hand

lines.zh: 我一天没吃东西，头有点晕
lines.en: A day without food, my head is light

lines.zh: 雷打在山上，我半身发麻
lines.en: Lightning struck the mountain and numbed half of me

lines.zh: 这里没有落脚的地方，我的东西也没处放
lines.en: Nowhere to stand here, and nowhere for my load
